title: A month, stamped
label: A desk calendar page for October 2026. A rubber stamp moves across the grid and stamps each working day approved, and each cell shows that day's payment count; busier days collect more overlapping impressions, so their ink is denser. Four held payments are marked HELD in the warning colour on three days, and a second approver's stamp clears each one a day or two later. Beside the page, the total adds up the stamped days, held payments counted once cleared, and reaches 1,284 payments signed with 0 unsigned, 4 held and 4 cleared. The month is sealed, then the page tears off the pad and leaves the next, empty page.
heading:
Every working
day, signed off.
sub: Each stamp is one day's payments, checked and approved. Held ones wait for a second approver, then get theirs.
